Junior Full Stack Software Engineer

Engineering/Design Palo Alto, California

Apply
Description

iSoftStone, Inc. is seeking a Junior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our Team 

in Palo Alto, CA!

*THIS IS A W2 CONTRACT POSITION*

 **Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.** 

Responsibilities: 

Web Application Development: Build frontend pages, backend APIs, and database components for admin applications, and independently deliver well-defined features.
Business Systems and Workflows: Develop business features, configure workflows, and maintain applications on our existing platform.
Automation and Integrations: Integrate third-party and internal system APIs, and build scripts to automate repetitive tasks.
Data and System Maintenance: Own database schema design, queries, data reconciliation, and migrations; investigate and resolve system issues.
Engineering and Delivery: Follow development standards and participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and releases; work with business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver on time.

Qualifications: 

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or a related field, with 1+ year of web development experience (internships included). Recent graduates with strong fundamentals are welcome to apply.
Proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript and React, with the ability to build pages and UI interactions independently.
Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Node.js, Python, or Java), with the ability to design and implement RESTful APIs independently.
Strong SQL and relational database skills, including schema design and basic query optimization.
Familiarity with Git collaboration workflows, solid debugging skills, and a habit of writing unit tests.
Strong learning ability, ownership, and clear communication; proactively reports progress and risks.

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience building admin systems, workflows, or automation tools.
Experience integrating third-party APIs, or familiarity with OAuth or Webhooks.
Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.

PayRange: $38 to $42/hour 

iSoftStone is a global IT service and consulting company that creates value and drives success through technology solutions, service excellence, and digital innovation. We specialize in web and application development, software testing and support, data and content management, digital experience, accessibility, and data for machine learning and AI. With 20 delivery centers and more than 90,000 employees worldwide, iSoftStone is proud to serve some of the world’s most well-known businesses, including 90+ Fortune Global 500 companies. 

Visit us at https://www.isoftstoneinc.com.

iSoftStone is committed to the practice of equal opportunity for all its employees and applicants in employment, and does not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnicity, color, age, national origin, religion, creed, marital status, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, status as an honorably discharged veteran or disabled veteran or military status, political affiliation or belief, citizenship/status as a lawfully admitted immigrant authorized to work in the United States, or presence of any physical, sensory, or mental disability. In addition, reasonable accommodation will be made for known physical or mental limitations for all otherwise qualified persons with disabilities.
